m_CollisionGroup.desc: What it collides with, by group number (e.g. 1 = debris: players walk through).

m_Glow.m_glowColorOverride.desc: Outline colour as one number: red + green x 256 + blue x 65536 (0 = the game's colour).

m_Glow.m_iGlowType.desc: Outline glow: 0 off, 1 when used, 2 when looked at, 3 always (through walls).

m_Glow.m_nGlowRange.desc: How far away the outline shows (0 = any distance).

m_Glow.m_nGlowRangeMin.desc: The outline only shows beyond this distance.

m_Local.m_iHideHUD.desc: Hides parts of a player's HUD (a bit mask; 0 shows everything). The game sets it again itself within a second: set it on a timer to keep it.

m_afButtonDisabled.desc: Buttons a player's presses are ignored for (a bit mask).

m_afButtonForced.desc: Buttons held down for a player whatever they press (a bit mask; 1 = attack).

m_bIsOnThirdStrike.desc: 1 when a survivor is black and white (the next fall kills).

m_bSurvivorGlowEnabled.desc: 1 shows the survivors' outlines to this player.

m_clrRender.desc: Colour tint and see-through amount as one number: red + green x 256 + blue x 65536 + alpha x 16777216.

m_currentReviveCount.desc: How many times a survivor has been revived since their last heal (3 = black and white).

m_fFlags.desc: State bits (on the ground, ducking, frozen...).

m_flCycle.desc: How far through its animation it is, 0 to 1 (hold it with Playback Rate 0).

m_flGravity.desc: Gravity multiplier for a player: 1 normal, 0.5 floaty (0 counts as 1).

m_flLaggedMovementValue.desc: Speed multiplier: 1 normal, 2 twice as fast, 0.5 half (players and the infected).

m_flModelScale.desc: Model size: 1 normal, 2 twice as big (props and other models).

m_frustration.desc: A Tank's frustration, 0 to 100 (at 100 a player Tank loses control).

m_hOwnerEntity.desc: The entity that owns it (a weapon's holder, a projectile's thrower).

m_hViewEntity.desc: The entity a player looks through, like a security camera (none = their own eyes).

m_healthBuffer.desc: A survivor's temporary health (pills, adrenaline, being revived), on top of Health; it drains away.

m_healthBufferTime.desc: When the temporary health was last set (it drains from then).

m_iAmmo.desc: A player's reserve ammo, one slot per ammo type (index = the type).

m_iFOV.desc: A player's field of view in degrees (0 = their own setting).

m_iMaxHealth.desc: Most health it can have (a survivor's 100; healing stops here).

m_isGhost.desc: 1 while an infected player is still a ghost (not spawned).

m_isGoingToDie.desc: 1 when a survivor will die if incapacitated again.

m_nBody.desc: Which body groups the model shows (a number that combines them).

m_nRenderFX.desc: Drawing effects (pulse, flicker, fade...), by number.

m_nRenderMode.desc: How it's drawn (1 or 10 let the alpha in Render Colour make it see-through; 10 = hidden).

m_nSkin.desc: Which skin (texture set) the model shows.

m_nUpgradedPrimaryAmmoLoaded.desc: Incendiary or explosive rounds left in a weapon.

m_takedamage.desc: Whether it can be hurt: 0 never, 1 damage events only (no health lost), 2 normally.

m_upgradeBitVec.desc: A weapon's upgrades as bits (1 incendiary, 2 explosive, 4 laser sight).

m_vecVelocity.desc: How fast it's moving (read only for most things).

m_zombieClass.desc: Which infected a player is: 1 Smoker, 2 Boomer, 3 Hunter, 4 Spitter, 5 Jockey, 6 Charger, 8 Tank (9 survivor).

source: the game itself: a recorded demo's property tables, and NetProps asked on every class
